Definition
[CMC boundary conditions] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0236 1. ch33:33.1\group Hyperbolic pieces

Let $F:(\mathcal H_A,h)\to (\mathcal M,g)$ be an embedding. It satisfies the CMC boundary conditions when every component of $F(\partial \mathcal H_A)$ has constant mean curvature and area $A$, and $F_*N$ is normal to $F(\partial \mathcal H_A)$, where $N$ is the outward unit normal of $\partial \mathcal H_A$ with respect to $h$.
